author: barnabasbusa
content:
Lighthouse and Nimbus don't stay peered

    •    Nimbus drops all three Lighthouse nodes just after slot 3. Every Lighthouse reconnect then fails at the Status handshake, so Lighthouse bans one Nimbus node and loops on the other.
    •    Lodestar peers with everyone and bridges the two, so the chain still finalizes.
    •    The likely cause is QUIC between the two clients: all their connections are QUIC and Nimbus counts 394 failed incoming upgrades. This is not proven, and the reason for the first drop is unknown

author: barnabasbusa
content:
Nimbus misses about 12% of attestations

    •    Over 11 epochs, 21 of 176 Nimbus duties were not fully credited, against 2 of 264 for Lighthouse and 0 of 264 for Lodestar.
    •    Nimbus sends every attestation; they just aren't always included. This is most likely a consequence of problem 1, since its votes only reach Lighthouse proposers through Lodestar.
